title: DecTube
tagline: DecTube: Decentralized YouTube. Upload, share, and watch videos. Privacy, censorship resistance, data ownership. Connect with creators, independent content discovery.
description: This project is about a decentralized YouTube alternative where users can upload videos and share them with anyone. Currently in the development phase, all videos will be uploaded to Livepeer and IPFS, ensuring seamless video streaming. The platform will also include a private access control feature, where users will have to subscribe to creators in order to watch their videos.
how_its_made: A decentralized YouTube platform has been created using Livepeer and IPFS on the Polygon Mumbai blockchain. All videos are uploaded to Livepeer, allowing them to be played on any network without buffering or concerns about low internet speed. For the frontend, Next.js has been utilized.
